failure.assertion: tools/membrane-kv-exact-sim/test_mem_guard.cpp:58: a budget far above real RSS takes no action
failure.root_cause_analysis: mem_guard_t (Phase 6.5) reads REAL /proc/meminfo system-wide MemAvailable/SwapTotal/SwapFree in addition to this process's own RSS vs its declared budget -- the test's premise (a 1 TiB budget, far above any process RSS, should force mem_action_t::NONE) does not hold when the REAL system-wide available memory is itself critically low, which it was throughout this session (as low as ~170-320 MiB free). This is a pre-existing sensitivity of a Phase 6.5 test to real host memory pressure, not something Phase 11E's changes caused -- Phase 11E touched no file under tools/membrane-kv-exact-sim/. Not fixed here: out of this phase's scope (constrained-mixed-vs-q5 research only), and 'fixing' a memory-guard test's behavior under real memory pressure by loosening its assertion would be exactly the kind of scope creep this phase's instructions forbid.
